end.parentNote: Anika practised noticing how a curved surface helps objects roll and how a flat top can help objects stack. They first said a tin would not roll, then corrected this after considering its side; this was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, try rolling a bottle or tin on its side and then standing it upright to discuss what changes.
